Name: FriendRadar
Author: Liquidize
Punchline: See where your friends are and what they are doing, once they opt in.
Description:
FriendRadar shows opted-in friends on a radar, on the zone map and in a live activity list: which zone and instance they are in, what duty they are running, which job they are playing and whether they are fighting, gathering, crafting or idling.

Nothing is shared until you turn sharing on, pick who to share with and choose which details to include. Presence updates are end-to-end encrypted for each recipient, so a relay only ever moves opaque blobs it cannot read. Point the plugin at your own relay, or a friend's, and delete your account whenever you like.
